title: SVP of Software Engineering @ Trilogy (New Products)
body:
Built independent department from 6 to 40 people while scaling from 3 to 11 concurrent products, achieving 3x productivity improvement. Managing $6M/year budget with full autonomy over team structure and processes.

Education technology focus: Shipped 7+ learning products from concept to production spanning three pillars: learning apps (TrashCat, Athena, TeachTap, TeachTales, Magic Academy, ReadingCritters), content infrastructure (Incept platform for curriculum modeling, AI-powered content generation, QTI standardization), and analytics (TimeBack for student engagement tracking and outcome measurement).

Implemented learning science principles directly: spaced repetition, mastery-based progression, automaticity building, knowledge graphs for prerequisite relationships. This work enables thousands of Alpha School students to achieve 99th percentile outcomes. Also extended Crossover hiring platform and Trilogy Sales Platform.
